model_choice: Standard MCLP with coverage indicators. N~280 sites -> 560 variables. Fits CGA backend (limit 3600) with room for overhead. Uses linear constraints for cardinality and coverage implications.

cover.meaning: List of pairs (i, j) where site j covers site i (distance <= 1km)

derived.how: Compute pairwise distances, keep pairs with dist <= 1000m

k.meaning: Number of charging stations to select
